name: command-deck
description: Plan with the right model per task, kanban board, usage and git panel, caveman toggle, handoff memory.

autoStart.title: Auto-start the deck in every new chat (1 on, 0 off)
autoStart.description: When on, each new chat opens the Command Deck pane and turns auto-plan on. When off, open it yourself with /deck.

autoCompactPct.title: Auto-compact at context % (only when auto handoff is off)
autoCompactPct.description: Compact instead of handing off. Used only if the handoff percent is 0. 0 turns it off.

autoFresh.title: Move to a new chat on a new topic (1 on, 0 off)
autoFresh.description: When a long chat gets a message that starts a new topic, write a handoff, clear the chat and send the message there. 0 only suggests it.

handoffTurns.title: Suggest a handoff after N prompts
handoffTurns.description: After this many prompts, a prompt that starts a new feature gets a handoff suggestion. 0 turns it off.

cavemanRatio.title: Caveman output saving (0 to 0.9)
cavemanRatio.description: Share of output tokens Caveman mode is assumed to spare. Used only for the saved estimate.

ponytailRatio.title: Ponytail output saving (0 to 0.9)
ponytailRatio.description: Share of output tokens Ponytail is assumed to spare (its benchmark: 45 percent fewer). Used only for the saved estimate; 0 turns the row's figure off.

graphifyTokensPerCall.title: Graphify saving per query
graphifyTokensPerCall.description: Estimated tokens spared by each graphify query, path or explain call (it does not report its own).

optimizerTokensPerCall.title: Context optimizer saving per call
optimizerTokensPerCall.description: Estimated tokens spared by each token-optimizer smart_* call (it does not report its own).

inputDollarsPerMTok.title: Input price, dollars per million tokens
inputDollarsPerMTok.description: Used to turn saved input tokens into dollars.

outputDollarsPerMTok.title: Output price, dollars per million tokens
outputDollarsPerMTok.description: Used to turn saved output tokens into dollars.

autoFreshPct.title: Handoff and clear at context %
autoFreshPct.description: When the context window passes this percent, write a handoff, clear the chat and continue from it. 0 turns it off.

coldGuard.title: Cold-cache guard (0 off, 1 warn, 2 refuse)
coldGuard.description: When the prompt cache has probably gone cold on a big context, show the rewrite cost. 2 also drops the first send once so you can choose.

cacheTtlMin.title: Prompt cache lifetime, minutes
cacheTtlMin.description: 60 for a subscription's one-hour cache. Use 5 for API-key billing unless promptCacheTtl is 1h.

coldMinTokens.title: Minimum context for the guard and keep-warm
coldMinTokens.description: Below this many tokens a cold rewrite is cheap, so nothing is done.

autoKeepWarm.title: Keep the cache warm automatically (1 on, 0 off)
autoKeepWarm.description: Turn keep-warm on once the context is big, and after a cold cache is detected.

warmPingMin.title: Keep-warm ping after idle minutes
warmPingMin.description: One tool-less fork after this many idle minutes. Must be under the cache lifetime.

warmHours.title: Keep-warm window, hours
warmHours.description: How long keep-warm stays on before it stops by itself.

smartTools.title: Smart MCP deferral (1 on, 0 off)
smartTools.description: On a chat's first prompt, move MCP servers the work does not need behind tool search (still reachable on demand). /deck tools off undoes it.

routingSaveRatio.title: Routing saving ratio
routingSaveRatio.description: Share of a Haiku task's tokens counted as saved against running it on Sonnet (price gap).

plannerChatMessages.title: Recent messages shown to the planner
plannerChatMessages.description: How many of the latest chat messages the planner reads so it does not ask what the chat already settled. 0 sends none.

plannerChatChars.title: Characters kept per message sent to the planner
plannerChatChars.description: Longer messages are cut to this length before the planner sees them.
